name: Deterministic Vessel Deployment with Rollback
description: Fully deterministic CI/CD deployment for vessels using only bash resolvers. Includes pre-deploy rollback to clear stuck releases, version validation, and retry-enabled health checks with proper exit codes.

variables.name: vesselName
variables.description: Name of the vessel to deploy (e.g., 'metabob-activity-api')

variables.name: environment
variables.description: Target environment: local, canary, or production

tasks.description: Validate all required tools and context exist

config.command: set -e; echo '=== Validating Prerequisites ==='; for cmd in docker kubectl helmfile yq jq curl git; do if ! command -v $cmd &>/dev/null; then echo "MISSING: $cmd"; exit 1; fi; echo "OK: $cmd"; done; if [ ! -d '{{deploymentRepo}}' ]; then echo "MISSING: deployment repo at {{deploymentRepo}}"; exit 1; fi; if [ ! -d '{{deploymentRepo}}/vessels/{{vesselName}}' ]; then echo "MISSING: vessel directory at {{deploymentRepo}}/vessels/{{vesselName}}"; exit 1; fi; echo '=== All prerequisites validated ==='

tasks.description: Detect version, commit SHA, and validate package.json exists

config.command: set -e; cd '{{deploymentRepo}}/vessels/{{vesselName}}'; if [ ! -f package.json ]; then echo 'ERROR: package.json not found'; exit 1; fi; VERSION=$(jq -r '.version // "0.1.0"' package.json); SHA=$(git rev-parse --short=7 HEAD); TAG="$VERSION-$SHA"; echo "VERSION=$VERSION"; echo "SHA=$SHA"; echo "TAG=$TAG"; echo "IMAGE=metabobapp/{{vesselName}}:$TAG"; if [ -z "$VERSION" ] || [ -z "$SHA" ]; then echo 'ERROR: Could not detect version or SHA'; exit 1; fi

tasks.description: Check if Docker image already exists in registry

config.command: SKIP='{{skipBuild}}'; if [ "$SKIP" = 'true' ]; then echo 'SKIPPED: skipBuild=true - will use existing image'; exit 0; fi; cd '{{deploymentRepo}}/vessels/{{vesselName}}'; TAG="$(jq -r '.version' package.json)-$(git rev-parse --short=7 HEAD)"; echo "Checking for existing image: metabobapp/{{vesselName}}:$TAG"; if docker manifest inspect "metabobapp/{{vesselName}}:$TAG" &>/dev/null; then echo 'IMAGE_EXISTS=true'; echo 'Image already exists in registry - build will be skipped unless forced'; else echo 'IMAGE_EXISTS=false'; echo 'Image not found - will build'; fi

tasks.description: Update environment values with new image tag

config.command: SKIP='{{skipDeploy}}'; if [ "$SKIP" = 'true' ]; then echo 'SKIPPED: skipDeploy=true'; exit 0; fi; cd '{{deploymentRepo}}'; TAG=$(cd vessels/{{vesselName}} && echo "$(jq -r '.version' package.json)-$(git rev-parse --short=7 HEAD)"); VALUES_FILE="environments/{{environment}}.values.yaml"; if [ ! -f "$VALUES_FILE" ]; then echo "ERROR: Values file not found: $VALUES_FILE"; exit 1; fi; echo "Updating $VALUES_FILE with tag: $TAG"; CURRENT=$(yq eval '."{{vesselName}}".image.tag // "none"' "$VALUES_FILE"); echo "Current tag: $CURRENT"; yq eval -i '."{{vesselName}}".image.tag = "'$TAG'"' "$VALUES_FILE"; echo "Updated to: $TAG"

tasks.description: Build Docker image with build context from vessels directory

config.command: SKIP='{{skipBuild}}'; if [ "$SKIP" = 'true' ]; then echo 'SKIPPED: skipBuild=true'; exit 0; fi; cd '{{deploymentRepo}}'; TAG=$(cd vessels/{{vesselName}} && echo "$(jq -r '.version' package.json)-$(git rev-parse --short=7 HEAD)"); DOCKERFILE="vessels/{{vesselName}}/Dockerfile"; if [ ! -f "$DOCKERFILE" ]; then echo "ERROR: Dockerfile not found: $DOCKERFILE"; exit 1; fi; echo "Building metabobapp/{{vesselName}}:$TAG"; docker build -f "$DOCKERFILE" -t "metabobapp/{{vesselName}}:$TAG" -t "metabobapp/{{vesselName}}:latest" vessels/ || { echo 'ERROR: Docker build failed'; exit 1; }; echo "Built: metabobapp/{{vesselName}}:$TAG"

SKIP='{{skipPush}}'; if [ "$SKIP" = 'true' ]; then echo 'SKIPPED: skipPush=true'; exit 0; fi; SKIP_BUILD='{{skipBuild}}'; if [ "$SKIP_BUILD" = 'true' ]; then echo 'SKIPPED: skipBuild=true implies skipPush'; exit 0; fi; cd '{{deploymentRepo}}'; TAG=$(cd vessels/{{vesselName}} && echo "$(jq -r '.version' package.json)-$(git rev-parse --short=7 HEAD)"); echo "Pushing metabobapp/{{vesselName}}:$TAG"; docker push "metabobapp/{{vesselName}}:$TAG" || { echo 'ERROR: Failed to push versioned tag'; exit 1; }; docker push "metabobapp/{{vesselName}}:latest" || echo 'WARNING: Failed to push latest tag (non-fatal)'; echo "Pushed: metabobapp/{{vesselName}}:$TAG"

tasks.description: Rollback any stuck/pending Helm release before deploying

config.command: SKIP='{{skipDeploy}}'; if [ "$SKIP" = 'true' ]; then echo 'SKIPPED: skipDeploy=true'; exit 0; fi; echo '=== Pre-Deploy Rollback Check ==='; RELEASE_STATUS=$(helm status {{vesselName}} -n {{namespace}} 2>/dev/null | grep -i 'STATUS:' | awk '{print $2}' || echo 'not-found'); echo "Current release status: $RELEASE_STATUS"; if [ "$RELEASE_STATUS" = 'pending-install' ] || [ "$RELEASE_STATUS" = 'pending-upgrade' ] || [ "$RELEASE_STATUS" = 'failed' ]; then echo "Detected stuck release ($RELEASE_STATUS), rolling back..."; helm rollback {{vesselName}} -n {{namespace}} --wait --timeout 120s 2>/dev/null || helm uninstall {{vesselName}} -n {{namespace}} --wait 2>/dev/null || true; echo 'Rollback/cleanup completed'; else echo 'No stuck release detected, proceeding'; fi

SKIP='{{skipDeploy}}'; if [ "$SKIP" = 'true' ]; then echo 'SKIPPED: skipDeploy=true'; exit 0; fi; cd '{{deploymentRepo}}'; echo '=== Deploying {{vesselName}} ==='; TAG=$(cd vessels/{{vesselName}} && echo "$(jq -r '.version' package.json)-$(git rev-parse --short=7 HEAD)"); echo "Deploying tag: $TAG"; helmfile -f helmfile.yaml.gotmpl --environment {{environment}} -l name={{vesselName}} sync || { echo 'ERROR: Helmfile sync failed'; exit 1; }; echo '=== Waiting for rollout ==='; kubectl rollout status deployment/{{vesselName}} -n {{namespace}} --timeout=300s || { echo 'WARNING: Rollout status check failed (may still be deploying)'; }; echo 'Deploy completed'

tasks.description: Verify deployment health with configurable retries

config.command: SKIP='{{skipDeploy}}'; if [ "$SKIP" = 'true' ]; then echo 'SKIPPED: skipDeploy=true - no health check needed'; exit 0; fi; RETRIES={{healthCheckRetries}}; INTERVAL={{healthCheckInterval}}; echo "=== Health Check (max $RETRIES attempts, ${INTERVAL}s interval) ==="; for i in $(seq 1 $RETRIES); do STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --connect-timeout 10 '{{healthEndpoint}}' 2>/dev/null || echo '000'); if [ "$STATUS" = '200' ]; then echo "HEALTHY: HTTP $STATUS (attempt $i)"; curl -s '{{healthEndpoint}}' | jq -c . 2>/dev/null || true; exit 0; fi; echo "Attempt $i/$RETRIES: HTTP $STATUS"; if [ "$i" -lt "$RETRIES" ]; then sleep $INTERVAL; fi; done; echo "FAILED: Health check failed after $RETRIES attempts"; exit 1

tasks.description: Commit updated values file (optional, for GitOps)

config.command: SKIP='{{skipDeploy}}'; if [ "$SKIP" = 'true' ]; then echo 'SKIPPED: skipDeploy=true'; exit 0; fi; cd '{{deploymentRepo}}'; VALUES_FILE="environments/{{environment}}.values.yaml"; if git diff --quiet "$VALUES_FILE" 2>/dev/null; then echo 'No changes to commit'; exit 0; fi; TAG=$(cd vessels/{{vesselName}} && echo "$(jq -r '.version' package.json)-$(git rev-parse --short=7 HEAD)"); echo "Committing values update for {{vesselName}}:$TAG"; git add "$VALUES_FILE"; git commit --no-verify -m "chore(deploy): update {{vesselName}} to $TAG" || echo 'No commit created (may already be committed)'; echo 'Values file committed (push manually if needed)'

improvements_over_v3: Added pre-deploy rollback to clear stuck releases
Added configurable health check retries and intervals
Added skipBuild option to use existing images
Added commit task for GitOps workflows
Better error messages with exit codes
All tasks use shell conditionals instead of Handlebars
